shadows.name: panel
shadows.value: 0 22px 38px -10px var(--color-panel-shadow), 0 5px 12px -5px var(--color-panel-shadow), inset 0 1px 0 var(--color-panel-edge), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--color-panel-shadow)

components.name: Dimensional card
components.description: Shared inner/contact material; service cards also include approved short descriptions. Illustration figures retain natural aspect ratio with these panel borders and shadows.

components.name: Header navigation
components.description: Four shared routes use React Router Link rendered as SSR anchors. Full-width sticky header has top:0, z-index:20, 94%-opaque theme fill and 10px blur; inner responsive dimensions are unchanged.

narrative.overview: The owner approved the navy/cyan domestic-engineering world, drop mark and dimensional glass panels for the complete existing site. A cinematic home introduction leads into calm service content; inner pages carry the same materials without repeating the room photograph. Dark is the default, with a persistent light alternative.
keyCharacteristics: Domestic engineering imagery with readable HTML foreground.
Local Manrope, cyan actions and an approved drop mark.
Soft dimensional panels balanced with ruled editorial sections.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Use shared role tokens rather than copying a dark color into a new surface; saved light mode must remain coherent.

rules.name: The Material Continuity Rule
rules.body: Reuse the panel material for actual containers; retain open ruled sections for editorial content.

dos: Do use shared semantic theme tokens across all routes.
Do keep the approved room illustration on the homepage without representing it as project photography.
Do reuse approved contacts, services, SVG icons and the shared non-submitting form.
donts: Don't present generated imagery as completed company work.
Don't invent projects, published articles, metrics or social destinations.
Don't simulate form delivery or introduce new business claims.
